biotools.summary: EpiFusionUtilities is an R package that provides tools for using the EpiFusion Analysis Framework, a workflow for joint phylodynamic and epidemiological analysis of outbreaks. It complements the EpiFusion software and offers utilities for data preparation, result parsing, analysis, and plotting.
